pieces.name: Quarter dome shell, radius 3 m
pieces.notes: Row Radius 3 m. Pivot is the dome centre on the floor plane, not the bounding-box centre, so quarter, half and full shells of one radius share it and join on their cut edges (cut edges on the X=0 / Z=0 planes, shell behind). Rim sockets Ø0.6 m. The opening is a burl collar on the curved face, offset measured from the face's midline. Only window burls fit the r3 quarter. Blockout pass: sockets are root anchors at the dome surface (and a crown anchor), sized by radius; openings are given by azimuth and sill height and cut through the shell.

prefabs.name: Root Flare Home
prefabs.notes: Blockout pass: the sheet's three quarter shells left a 5 m gap, so it is a full r5 dome; four flares carry 90° roots that grip the dome's anchors.

prefabs.name: Hanging Pod Home
prefabs.notes: Blockout pass: a 4 m trunk lifts the bend so the pod clears the ground; the pod hangs from the bend's hang point.
